# Revision history for parmenides

## 0.1.0.0 -- 2026-10-30

* Stable API but untested reliability

## 0.1.0.1 -- 2026-11-03

* The resources generated by the setup cmd are added to gitignore automatically

## 1.0.0.0 -- 2026-11-15

* Added Sqlite support
* Added Dialect module which enables support for multiple databases
* Refactored Log module
* Better error reporting tools for devs
* Removed findMigration command
* Removed the ability to find untracked migrations and track them. Everything goes through mkMigration command
* Added small helper functions for command argument parsing

## 1.0.0.1 -- 2026-11-22

* Added Dialect.StatementParser module
* Can now execute multiple statements in a single migration

## 1.1.0.0 -- 2026-11-27

* Added new `readMigrations` command
* Can now track migrations that were not created by the `mkMigration` command.
  This enables developers who work on the same project to share migrations or use the migrations pulled from remote.
